# Paths inside the redesigned Purview portal are breadcrumbs; deep-link rot is tracked in docs/17 B6.

column8: path
column9: desc
The suite home: risk and compliance solutions on the left; unified governance lives in the catalog.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Audit
column9: The master activity log across workloads. Standard keeps 180 days; Premium one year with high-value events like MailItemsAccessed.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > eDiscovery > Content search
column9: Search and export across mailboxes and sites without opening a case; eDiscovery (Standard) capability from E3.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > eDiscovery
column9: Cases with holds and searches and exports. Premium adds custodians and collections and review sets on E5.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Information protection > Activity explorer
column9: Label and DLP activity over time: what got labeled or downgraded or matched where.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Information protection > Content explorer
column9: Browse where sensitive info and labels actually sit; access to content itself needs the extra viewer role groups.

column8: Purview portal > Data classification > Sensitive info types
column9: Built-in and custom sensitive info types; test any SIT against sample text from its flyout.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Data classification > Classifiers
column9: Trainable classifiers: pre-trained business categories plus your own seeded ones.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Information protection
column9: Sensitivity labels: scopes and publishing and encryption and auto-labeling.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Data loss prevention
column9: DLP policies across Exchange SharePoint OneDrive Teams endpoints and on-prem; alerts surface in the Defender portal.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Data lifecycle management
column9: Retention policies and labels plus the import service; adaptive scopes are the premium layer.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Records management
column9: Declare records and run disposition review; the locked end of the retention spectrum.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Insider risk management
column9: Risky-user cases from signals like departing-employee data theft; feeds adaptive protection into Conditional Access.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Communication compliance
column9: Monitored channels and policy violations for regulated or sensitive communication.

column8: Priva > Privacy risk management
column9: Priva privacy posture: overexposed personal data findings and policies. Separate Priva licensing.

column8: Priva > Subject rights requests
column9: DSAR intake and collection and review; the subject rights request runbook lives on this surface. Separate Priva licensing.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Compliance Manager
column9: Assessments and improvement actions and the compliance score.

column8: Purview portal > Settings > Roles and scopes
column9: Purview role groups admin: where eDiscovery Manager and Audit Reader are granted; separate from Entra roles.

column8: Defender portal > App governance
column9: OAuth app policies and alerts; operated with Defender for Cloud Apps despite the Purview branding.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > Information barriers
column9: Blocks communication and collaboration between defined segments in Teams SharePoint and OneDrive.

column8: Purview portal > Solutions > DSPM for AI
column9: AI usage posture: Copilot and third-party AI prompt activity with oversharing findings and one-click protection policies.

column8: Defender portal > Policies & rules > Alert policy
column9: Default and custom activity alert policies with mail routing: where "why did nobody get told" investigations end.
